description: Add CSS styling for the .gallery-cta class used in both the main gallery (index.njk) and photo gallery (gallery.njk) sections to create a distinctive, conversion-focused call-to-action element.

phases.name: Implementation
phases.description: Add the .gallery-cta CSS styles to the stylesheet following existing design patterns

subtasks.title: Add base .gallery-cta styles
subtasks.description: Add the core .gallery-cta CSS class with background, padding, border-radius, text alignment, and margin. Use the existing design tokens (--color-background-alt, --spacing-*, --radius-*) for consistency. Position after the photo gallery section in the CSS file.
acceptance_criteria: .gallery-cta class uses a distinct background color (--color-background-alt or subtle variant)
Border-radius using --radius-md or --radius-lg for visual softness
Top margin to separate from gallery content
Subtle border to define the CTA box

subtasks.title: Style .gallery-cta typography and links
subtasks.description: Add typography styles for paragraphs within .gallery-cta including font size, color, and margin. Style the links to be distinctive with the accent color and appropriate hover states to encourage clicks.
acceptance_criteria: Paragraph text uses appropriate font size (--font-size-base or slightly larger)
Links stand out with accent color (--color-accent)
Link hover states with underline or color change
Proper paragraph spacing within the CTA

subtasks.title: Add responsive styles for .gallery-cta
subtasks.description: Add responsive adjustments for mobile and tablet viewports to ensure the CTA looks good and remains readable across all screen sizes.
acceptance_criteria: CTA remains visually appealing on all viewport sizes

phases.name: Verification
phases.description: Test and verify the implementation works correctly

subtasks.title: Build and verify visual output
subtasks.description: Run the build process and verify the .gallery-cta styling appears correctly in both locations (index page gallery section and photo gallery page).
acceptance_criteria: CTA is visible on main gallery section (index.njk)
CTA is visible on photo gallery page (gallery.njk)
CTA stands out from surrounding content
Links are clearly clickable and have hover states

final_acceptance: .gallery-cta appears styled on both index.njk and gallery.njk pages
CTA stands out visually as a call-to-action element
Links are distinctive and have proper hover states
Responsive design works on mobile, tablet, and desktop
notes: The .gallery-cta class is used in two locations: src/index.njk (line 171) and src/gallery.njk (line 55)
Each CTA has slightly different content - one invites atelier visits, the other links to paintings/exhibitions
CSS should be added after the photo-gallery section styles (around line 782) for organizational consistency
Use existing design tokens for colors, spacing, typography to maintain consistency
The accent color (--color-tint: #FF1493 - deep pink) should be used for links to draw attention
